reason: GPU-accelerated analytical query processing is often limited by both GPU device memory capacity and host-to-device data transfer time. Modern data compression techniques, such as cascaded lightweight compression, can mitigate these issues. However, existing designs all exhibit critical tradeoffs on compression ratios, decompression speed, and extensibility. They either apply aggressive compression without addressing execution irregularity, or maintain strictly aligned data layouts that sacrifice compressibility. Al
title: G-CasDec: General Cascaded Decompression on GPUs
